latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-video-translation v0.0.1

- Initial release of Alibaba Cloud IMS-based video translation skill.
- Supports subtitle extraction (ASR/OCR), translation, and speech synthesis translation.
- Handles multiple video input formats: HTTP URL, oss://, and local files (including OSS upload workflow).
- Enforces strict phase/order: environment check, translation mode, subtitle processing, output path, and optional subtitle review.
- Guides users through all required preparations with targeted prompts, including input formatting and upload instructions.
- Includes comprehensive scenario and parameter handling instructions for robust workflow coverage.
